sourceFacts.fact: Osmotic diarrhoea due to ingested poorly absorbed solute tends to improve when that solute is removed.
Secretory diarrhoea can persist despite fasting; patterns may be mixed clinically.

labels: Osmotic and secretory diarrhoea respond differently
layout: Two clearly separated horizontal lanes of three nodes each. Top lane1 to2 to3 in ochre, bottom4 to5 to6 in teal. Exactly four arrows, none between lanes. Top uses square solute tokens, a crossed-out supply tag, then fewer water-drop tokens. Bottom uses a plain abstract flow arrow, ongoing blue dots, then many water-drop tokens. Label under title: A conceptual comparison, not a fasting instruction. Bottom note: Mixed mechanisms occur. Do not draw intestines, secretory cells, membranes, pumps in tissue, foods or a child. No recommendation to withhold food or fluids.
